title: DSC 106 Portfolio
description: A portfolio website created in DSC 106 which implements HTML, JavaScript, and CSS. It contains information such as projects, resume, and a contact page.

title: ChaosMonkey LLM
description: A tool that uses LLMs to try to break your code and find flaws. It uses an agentic workflow with four AI agents. The team picks apart your code and writes test cases to break it.

title: San Diego Housing Market Analyzer
description: An interactive dashboard designed to track rental trends in San Diego using live data from Craigslist. It scrapes data off of Craigslist using BeautifulSoup and Requests.

title: COGS 108 Final Project
description: Used Python and Jupyter Notebook to predict psychological distress through musical preference. Used a dataset from Kaggle and performed data cleaning and exploratory data analysis to form conclusions about the data.
